metadata.title: Lower bounds for the critical CR GJMS operator
metadata.abstract: We establish lower bounds for the critical CR GJMS operator on closed pseudo-Hermitian manifolds. In dimension $2n+1$, assuming embeddability, we obtain a lower bound involving the Heisenberg Sobolev norm of order $n+1$, modulo an $L^{2}$ term, on the orthogonal complement of the kernel. In dimension three, we prove that the CR Paneitz operator is bounded below without assuming embeddability. The proofs combine the Heisenberg calculus with a square-root construction based on the joint functional calculus of the sub-Laplacian and the Reeb vector field on the Heisenberg group. As an application, we show that the infinitely many negative eigenvalues of the CR Paneitz operator on the Rossi sphere have zero as their only accumulation point. Consequently, this operator does not have closed range.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 临界 CR GJMS 算子的下界
analysis.workSummary: 证明可嵌入闭伪 Hermitian 流形上临界 CR GJMS 的 Heisenberg Sobolev 下界，并在三维去掉可嵌入性仍得到 Paneitz 下有界。
analysis.breakthrough: 解释 Rossi 球的无限负特征值仅聚于零，并由此得到不闭值域。
analysis.limitations: 高维强估计在核的正交补且模去 L² 项；不能把下有界误解为非负或闭值域。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 辅助英语编辑、摘要与引言起草修改、文献查找及数学论证审查完善，并由作者独立核验。
